description: Test suite for the TUI submit handler and related utilities, including handling of command input, burst coalescing, and environment detection for Windows Git Bash fallback.

methods.name: createSubmitHarness
methods.description: Creates a test harness simulating the submit handler environment for testing input handling and command processing.

methods.name: createSubmitBurstCoalescer
methods.description: Creates a function that coalesces rapid submissions into a single multiline submission if enabled.

methods.name: shouldEnableWindowsGitBashPasteFallback
methods.description: Detects whether the environment should fallback for Windows Git Bash paste behavior based on platform and environment variables.
